title: 第十六课 · 你看过京剧吗
subtitle: Lesson 16 — 你看过京剧吗 · Have you ever seen a Beijing opera

items.en: to perform, to put on (a show)
I haven't seen a Beijing opera.

items.py: Nǐ zhīdào nǎr yǎn jīngjù ma?
items.en: Do you know where Beijing opera is performed?

items.py: Nǐ mǎi dào piào yǐhòu gàosu wǒ.
items.en: Let me know after you get the tickets.

items.zh: 我还没吃过北京烤鸭呢！
items.py: Wǒ hái méi chī guò Běijīng kǎoyā ne!
items.en: I haven't had any Beijing roast duck yet!

items.py: Wǒmen yīnggāi qù cháng yī cháng.
items.en: We should go and have a taste of it.
A friend of mine will come to see me.

items.py: Tā gèzi bù gāo yě bù ǎi.
items.en: She is neither tall nor short.

items.py: Mǎlì: Nǐ kàn guò jīngjù ma?
items.en: Mary: Have you ever seen a Beijing opera?
Mary: I've heard it's very interesting.

items.py: Dàwèi: Wǒ hěn xiǎng kàn, nǐ ne?
items.en: David: I'd love to see one. How about you?

items.zh: 玛丽：我也很想看。你知道哪儿演吗？
items.py: Mǎlì: Wǒ yě hěn xiǎng kàn. Nǐ zhīdào nǎr yǎn ma?
items.en: Mary: Me too. Do you know where they perform?
David: They often perform at the People's Theatre.

items.zh: 玛丽：那我们星期六去看，好不好？
items.py: Mǎlì: Nà wǒmen xīngqīliù qù kàn, hǎo bu hǎo?
items.en: Mary: Then let's go on Saturday, OK?

items.zh: 大卫：当然好。明天我去买票。
items.py: Dàwèi: Dāngrán hǎo. Míngtiān wǒ qù mǎi piào.
items.en: David: Of course. I'll go buy tickets tomorrow.

items.zh: 玛丽：买到票以后告诉我。
items.py: Mǎlì: Mǎi dào piào yǐhòu gàosu wǒ.
items.en: Mary: Let me know after you get the tickets.

items.zh: 和子：听说烤鸭是北京的名菜。
items.py: Hézǐ: Tīngshuō kǎoyā shì Běijīng de míngcài.
items.en: Hezi: I've heard roast duck is a famous Beijing dish.

items.py: Mǎlì: Wǒ hái méi chī guò ne!
items.en: Mary: I haven't tried it yet!

items.zh: 和子：我们应该去尝一尝。
items.py: Hézǐ: Wǒmen yīnggāi qù cháng yī cháng.
items.en: Hezi: We should go and have a taste.

items.zh: 玛丽：二十八号晚上我没事。
items.py: Mǎlì: Èrshíbā hào wǎnshang wǒ méi shì.
items.en: Mary: I'm free on the evening of the 28th.

items.zh: 和子：不行，有朋友来看我。
items.py: Hézǐ: Bù xíng, yǒu péngyou lái kàn wǒ.
items.en: Hezi: That won't work, a friend is coming to see me.

items.zh: 玛丽：三十号晚上怎么样？
items.en: Mary: How about the evening of the 30th?

items.py: Mǎlì: Nǐ rènshi nàge rén ma?
items.en: Mary: Do you know that person?

items.zh: 玛丽：穿白衬衫的那个人。
items.py: Mǎlì: Chuān bái chènshān de nàge rén.
items.en: Mary: The one wearing a white shirt.

items.zh: 大卫：认识，他是我的朋友。
items.py: Dàwèi: Rènshi, tā shì wǒ de péngyou.

items.zh: 大卫：他是大夫，在医院工作。
items.py: Dàwèi: Tā shì dàifu, zài yīyuàn gōngzuò.
items.en: David: He's a doctor; he works at a hospital.

items.zh: 玛丽：他看起来很年轻。今年多大了？
items.py: Mǎlì: Tā kàn qǐlái hěn niánqīng. Jīnnián duō dà le?
items.en: Mary: He looks very young. How old is he?

data.topic: 会话4 · Dialogue 4 (What does she look like?)

items.en: David: Excuse me, is Hezi here?

items.zh: 职员：和子？她长得怎么样？
items.py: Zhíyuán: Hézǐ? Tā zhǎng de zěnmeyàng?
items.en: Staff: Hezi? What does she look like?

items.zh: 大卫：她个子不高也不矮，头发不太长。
items.py: Dàwèi: Tā gèzi bù gāo yě bù ǎi, tóufa bú tài cháng.
items.en: David: She's neither tall nor short, with not very long hair.

items.zh: 职员：她今天穿什么衣服？
items.py: Zhíyuán: Tā jīntiān chuān shénme yīfu?
items.en: Staff: What is she wearing today?

items.py: Dàwèi: Tā chuān yī jiàn hóng máoyī.
items.en: David: She's wearing a red sweater.

items.zh: 职员：哦，是不是那个日本留学生？
items.py: Zhíyuán: Ó, shì bu shì nàge Rìběn liúxuéshēng?
items.en: Staff: Oh, is it that Japanese exchange student?

data.topic: 替换与扩展 · Substitution and Extension

items.zh: 你看过京剧吗？——你喝过那种茶吗？
items.py: Nǐ kàn guò jīngjù ma? —— Nǐ hē guò nà zhǒng chá ma?
items.en: Have you seen Beijing opera? — Have you tried that kind of tea?

items.zh: 你看过京剧吗？——你去过那个公园吗？
items.py: Nǐ kàn guò jīngjù ma? —— Nǐ qù guò nàge gōngyuán ma?
items.en: Have you seen Beijing opera? — Have you been to that park?

items.zh: 你看过京剧吗？——你问过价钱吗？
items.py: Nǐ kàn guò jīngjù ma? —— Nǐ wèn guò jiàqian ma?
items.en: Have you seen Beijing opera? — Have you asked about the price?

items.zh: 我们应该去尝一尝。——我们应该去吃一吃烤鸭。
items.py: Wǒmen yīnggāi qù cháng yī cháng. —— Wǒmen yīnggāi qù chī yī chī kǎoyā.
items.en: We should go have a taste. — We should go try the roast duck.

items.zh: 我们应该去看一看京剧。
items.py: Wǒmen yīnggāi qù kàn yī kàn jīngjù.
items.en: We should go see a Beijing opera.

items.zh: 我们应该去听一听音乐。
items.py: Wǒmen yīnggāi qù tīng yī tīng yīnyuè.
items.en: We should go listen to some music.

items.zh: 我们应该去找一找老师。
items.py: Wǒmen yīnggāi qù zhǎo yī zhǎo lǎoshī.
items.en: We should go look for the teacher.

items.zh: 买到票以后告诉我。——找到老师以后告诉玛丽。
items.py: Mǎi dào piào yǐhòu gàosu wǒ. —— Zhǎo dào lǎoshī yǐhòu gàosu Mǎlì.
items.en: Tell me after you get tickets. — Tell Mary after you find the teacher.

items.py: Mǎlì, kuài lái, yǒu rén zhǎo nǐ.
items.en: Mary, come quick, someone is looking for you.

items.zh: 你看杂技吗？——不看。昨天的练习我还没做呢。
items.py: Nǐ kàn zájì ma? —— Bù kàn. Zuótiān de liànxí wǒ hái méi zuò ne.
items.en: Are you going to see the acrobatics? — No. I haven't done yesterday's exercises yet.

items.zh: 他做什么工作？——他是大夫。
items.py: Tā zuò shénme gōngzuò? —— Tā shì dàifu.
items.en: What does he do? — He's a doctor.

items.zh: 她做什么工作？——她是律师。
items.py: Tā zuò shénme gōngzuò? —— Tā shì lǜshī.
items.en: What does she do? — She's a lawyer.

items.zh: 你爸爸做什么工作？——他是工程师。
items.py: Nǐ bàba zuò shénme gōngzuò? —— Tā shì gōngchéngshī.
items.en: What does your father do? — He's an engineer.

items.py: Chuān bái chènshān de nàge rén.
items.en: The person wearing a white shirt.

items.py: Chuān hóng máoyī de nàge rén.
items.en: The person wearing a red sweater.

items.py: Chuān hēi kùzi de nàge rén.

items.en: Which company does he work at?

items.py: Nàge dài yǎnjìng de rén shì shéi?
items.en: Who is the person wearing glasses?

items.py: Tā shì yī gè hěn hǎo de hùshi.
items.en: She is a very good nurse.

items.py: Tā zhǎng de xiàng tā bàba.

items.en: I have been to the Great Wall. (past experience)
Have you been to America? (V+过+没有 question form)

items.py: Wǒ méi qù guò nàge shūdiàn.
items.en: I've never been to that bookstore. (negative: 没+V+过)

语法 · Grammar (还没有……呢 · Not Yet)

items.py: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ hái bù zhīdào ne.
items.en: I still don't know about this matter.

items.py: Wǒ hái méi chī guò kǎoyā ne.
items.en: I haven't had roast duck yet.

items.py: Tā bù gāo yě bù ǎi.
items.en: He's neither tall nor short. (不...也不... pattern)

items.py: Tā bú pàng yě bú shòu.

items.zh: 听说中国的杂技很有意思，我还____。
items.py: Tīngshuō Zhōngguó de zájì hěn yǒu yìsi, wǒ hái ____.
items.en: (Fill in 没看过呢) I've heard Chinese acrobatics are interesting, I still...

items.zh: 你来过中国吗？来中国以后，你去过什么地方？
items.py: Nǐ lái guò Zhōngguó ma? Lái Zhōngguó yǐhòu, nǐ qù guò shénme dìfang?
items.en: Have you been to China? What places have you visited since coming?

items.zh: 来中国以后，你给家里打过电话吗？
items.py: Lái Zhōngguó yǐhòu, nǐ gěi jiālǐ dǎ guò diànhuà ma?
items.en: Have you called home since coming to China?

items.zh: 昨天晚上你做什么了？看电视了吗？
items.py: Zuótiān wǎnshang nǐ zuò shénme le? Kàn diànshì le ma?
items.en: What did you do last night? Did you watch TV?
Have you seen Beijing opera? (correct V+过+没有 form)

items.py: Mǎlì méi qù guò nàge shūdiàn.
items.en: Mary has never been to that bookstore. (correct negative form)

items.py: Wǒ hái méi chī guò wǔfàn ne.

items.zh: 以前我没看过中国的杂技，昨天晚上我看了。中国杂技很有意思，以后我还想看。
items.py: Yǐqián wǒ méi kàn guò Zhōngguó de zájì, zuótiān wǎnshang wǒ kàn le. Zhōngguó zájì hěn yǒu yìsi, yǐhòu wǒ hái xiǎng kàn.
items.en: (Retelling) Before I had never seen Chinese acrobatics; last night I saw them. They were very interesting; I want to see them again.

items.zh: 我也没吃过中国菜。小王说他会做中国菜，星期六请我吃。
items.py: Wǒ yě méi chī guò Zhōngguó cài. Xiǎo Wáng shuō tā huì zuò Zhōngguó cài, xīngqīliù qǐng wǒ chī.
items.en: (Retelling) I haven't tried Chinese food either. Xiao Wang says he can cook Chinese food and will treat me on Saturday.
